evidence_integrity_check.scope: File integrity and exact source slices, not independent engineering acceptance.

boundaries: Source verdicts, engineer feedback and later interpretations remain separate in linked records and decisions.
Unknown, unchecked and conditional claims are retained without being promoted to positive or negative technical controls.
External evidence is referenced by the hashes in decisions; this manifest does not claim those external files are stored in Git.
This entire package is evaluator-only. Discovery inputs must exclude it and all historical answers.
The repository is not an isolated discovery environment. Isolation must be verified before any independent model run.
No filter is accepted from the existence of a control-pair description alone.
remaining_before_scoring: Declare canonical target IDs and per-input technical/question denominators, applying the explicit overlap rules; do not sum atom and composite counts.
Seal run inputs, code, prompts, outputs and exposure log separately; measure runtime and costs.
Set numeric comparison acceptance budgets before comparative runs.
